artificer.name: Artificer
artificer.description: Upgrades equipped artifacts, exchanges similar artifacts and combines artifact sets for gold and, when required, mithril.
artificer.onVisitedMessage:
{Artificer}

I am a bit tired. Further work today costs twice as much.
artificer.onEmptyMessage:
{Artificer}

I am sorry, but I cannot help you. You have no eligible artifacts or lack the resources required for my work.
